messages:
alex: kicking off thread for the bridge-consensus gate for v4-int4-lite. came back with some odd rerank swaps and span misses on multi-turn docs.
nina: quick numbers? which slices and what deltas?
alex: rerank_mrr -3.7% on rerank/shortquery, span_exact -4.8% on extract/span-multi, affected weight ~1.8%. latency tail improved ~10ms.
omar: was this from a staggered canary or shadow run?
alex: staggered 5% traffic variant vs control. build-bot: deploybot: staggered canary started 4412345700 for v4-int4-lite region-eu-west
nina: propose rule: require ensemble consensus check across control, candidate, and candidate-altkv. trigger rollback if candidate loses majority on top-1 AND at least one metric delta beyond threshold.
omar: add safety: require consecutive windows=2 and bootstrap CI failing (95% CI not overlapping zero). also require min_samples 1000 for the slice.
alex: draft gate yaml snippet: ```yaml
gate:
  name: bridge-consensus-cooldown
  ensemble: ["control-fp16","candidate-int4","candidate-int4-altkv"]
  decision:
    majority_loss_threshold: 0.5
    metrics:
      - name: span_exact
        threshold_pct: -3.5
        min_samples: 1000
      - name: rerank_mrr
        threshold_pct: -2.5
        min_samples: 1000
  windows: 2
  cohort_filter:
    slices: ["extract/span-multi","rerank/shortquery"]
    min_traffic_pct: 1.5
  safety:
    require_latency_ok: true
    latency_metric: p95
    latency_margin_ms: 15
  action:
    on_violation: rollback_candidate
    notify: ["#oncall","#eng-ml"]
    cooldown_after_manual: 2h
```
nina: also add automated microshadow step: replay disagreeing samples to candidate-int4-altkv with kv-ttl=120s. if altkv recovers >70% of disagrees, mark cause as kv-warmup.
omar: agreed. if microshadow explains issue, convert rollback -> staged_pause and ticket for kv-ttl tuning.
eval-bot: eval-bot: window1 complete -> majority_loss fraction 0.58 for candidate-int4, span_exact delta -4.9% (95% CI [-6.2,-3.6]), rerank_mrr -3.9%, affected slices weight 1.8%
alex: metrics violate and majority_loss true. waiting for window2 to confirm. tagging @nina @omar
build-bot: microshadow started 4412345720 targeting disagreeing samples, ttl=120s, 30k samples
eval-bot: eval-bot: window2 complete -> majority_loss 0.61, span_exact -5.0% (CI [-6.4,-3.7]), rerank_mrr -4.1%, altkv microshadow recovered 72% of disagreements
alex: CI confirms, but microshadow recovery >70% -> likely kv warmup. switching action: pause promotion and open ops ticket instead of immediate rollback. creating ticket and notifying #oncall.
nina: good call. set manual cooldown and schedule longer shadow with ttl=180s during low traffic to validate.
omar: logging gate config + eval outputs to canary repo. will follow up with postmortem if longer shadow still fails.
